verses.sanskrit:
रुरुरुवाच।
              कथं हिंसितवान्सर्पान्स राजा जनमेजयः। सर्पा वा हिंसितास्तत्र किमर्थं द्विजसत्तम॥१॥
verses.english: Ruru said: O best of the twice-born, why did king Janamejaya become the destroyer of the snakes and how did he destroy them?

verses.sanskrit: किमर्थं मोक्षिताश्चैव पन्नगास्तेन धीमता। आस्तीकेन द्विजश्रेष्ठ श्रोतुमिच्छाम्यशेषतः॥२॥
verses.english: Why were they saved by wise Astika, the best of Brahmanas? I am desirous of hearing all this.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋषिरुवाच।
              श्रोष्यसि त्वं रुरो सर्वमास्तीकचरितं महत्। ब्राह्मणानां कथयतामित्युक्त्वान्तरधीयत॥३॥
verses.english: Rishi said: O Ruru, you will hear the important history of Astika from the Brahmanas. Saying this he disappeared.

verses.sanskrit:
सौतिरुवाच।
              रुरुश्चापि वनं सर्वं पर्यधावत्समन्ततः। तमृषिं नष्टमन्विच्छन्संश्रान्तो न्यपतद्भुवि॥४॥
verses.english: Sauti said: Ruru rushed in search of the Rishi, but he did not find him in all the forest. Finding him not, he sat down on the ground, much fatigued.

verses.sanskrit: स मोहे परमं गत्वा नष्टसंज्ञ इवाभवत्। तदृषेर्वचनं तथ्यं चिन्तयानः पुनःपुनः॥५॥
verses.english: He felt himself confounded and seemed to lose his senses. He repeatedly pondered over the Rishi's words.

verses.sanskrit: लब्धसंज्ञो रुरुश्चायात्तदाचख्यौ पितुस्तदा। पिता चास्य तदाख्यानं पृष्टः सर्वं न्यवेदयत्॥६॥
verses.english: Regaining his senses, he came home and asked his father (to relate the history) and his father related to him the story. End of Pau loma Parva
